sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for reaffirming our long-standing partnership. We request that the adjustment reflect the weighted movements of the indices you cited and take effect later, and we offer shorter payment terms in exchange for a lower price.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 8150 units per year for 12 months, 8150 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 127.31 per unit, valid from 2027-01-01, 14 days net; option B: EUR 127.18 per unit, valid from 2026-11-01, 14 days net; option C: EUR 127.64 per unit, valid from 2027-04-01, 14 days net. Option A amounts to about EUR 1037576 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-03 you quoted us EUR 126.53 per unit for this part; your new quote is 9.5% above it. Our demand forecast for this part is up +10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09). Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08). Your letter (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €136.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We also welcome the 14-day payment terms and the increased volume forecast, which we have factored into our revised calculation.
While the decrease in electric power costs provides some relief, it only partially offsets our significant increases in labor and other materials, bringing our revised offer to €133.80 per unit.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €133.80 per unit.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

You have confirmed the index, volume and notice-period data and factored shorter payment terms into your revised calculation. To support our ongoing partnership, we propose a deferred effective date and a price adjustment grounded in the verified labour and producer-price indices, accounting for lower electricity costs and a corresponding price concession in return for shorter payment terms.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 8150 units per year for 12 months, 8150 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 128.04 per unit, valid from 2027-01-01, 14 days net. This amounts to about EUR 1043526 over the term.
3. Basis: Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
